verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships an official desktop app, which community users praise as a slick single install. It also offers a web workspace, hosted by the vendor or self-hosted via Docker. Both surfaces go beyond chat, with RAG, agents, and on-device meeting transcription. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official mobile app, documentation confirming feature parity between the desktop and web/server versions, and independent corroboration of parity across surfaces.
